script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text says the fire consumed the outskirts, but it does not say it did not reach the middle.
The passage does not mention Aaron in this scene, but it does not establish that he was absent.
Papa Dorin says he carved his name into a handle. The Millers carved Dorin into his handle.
Saying the Israelites picked up the craving from the rabble adds a causal connection the text does not state.
The cited verse does not establish that the people had just left Sinai or that it was still close by.
The explanation says the longing starts as they look around, but the craving is already mentioned before this complaint.
Even marked as a bet, hearing the weeping in his sleep invents an event the text does not give.
Moses being 'running low' is an unmarked guess about his condition.
The explanation reverses the order: Moses asks whether he conceived or gave birth to the people before the carrying comparison.
Saying Moses is worn all the way down presents a guess about his condition as fact.
The people say they were better off in Egypt and ask why they left. The passage does not say they propose going back.
The text says the elders prophesied as the Spirit rested on them, but does not call their prophesying a sign.
The closing line about knowing moments that only come once is vague and generic rather than adding a meaningful Papa Dorin moment.
Calling it a surprise for Eldad and Medad assigns them a reaction the text does not give.
The text records Moses' wish, but does not say he is glad or that he is not bothered.
Moses wishes the Spirit on all the LORD's people, not on everybody without qualification.
The text describes quail around and near the camp; it does not say they covered the whole camp.
The text says the people stayed up gathering quail, but does not say nobody went back to a tent early.
Saying the name is meant to be remembered assigns an unstated purpose, even though it is marked as Papa Dorin's thought.
